# Data as objects — Style Prompt

> Real numbers built as real objects. One thin plate equals one stated quantity, every tenth plate is brass, and the stacks stand to exact scale on a walnut disc under soft studio light with long shadows. A low camera runs along the spiral of stacks, climbs to a locked three-quarter frame for the comparison, chases the last stack up as plates are placed one by one, and ends on a still, readable pile.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

- **The unit is an object.** One plate = one stated quantity (here 10 kg), said on screen once. A heavier material marks every tenth plate, so the stack is its own ruler.
- **Scale is exact.** Heights and counts are computed from the data; rounding is one plate at most. Two series on one base use the same unit.
- **Studio light, real matter.** Metal reflects, wood shows grain, tinted acrylic transmits; nothing glows, nothing is outlined, no fake UI.
- **Growth is assembly.** Data grows by plates being placed one after another, never by scaling or morphing.
- **A source on screen** for every number: the user's own ledger, a report, a published dataset.

Not a flat bar chart (no ink axes, no icons), not a neon dark-tech stage, not a toy-brick look (no characters, no toy proportions).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Plates**: 360 per stack, 8 px per plate on the side texture (painted once from a seeded PRNG): ±1 px offset, ±10 % value change, a dark hairline gap and a bright edge catch per plate; every 10th plate brass.
- **Two series, two materials**, separable at thumbnail size: brushed aluminium (olive-gold reflections on the sides) against tinted acrylic from `--aksen`. Brass is shared by both rulers.
- **Base**: a walnut disc (grain painted once to one image) with inlaid marks cut into it: a tick ring every 2°, big ticks every 30°, a circle, two dashed spiral paths, month names.
- **Depth** is real perspective: each stack is four side windows plus a top, placed with `matrix3d` from one camera; only the sides facing the camera show; stacks sort by depth. A long soft shadow from a key light at left (35°) is one SVG hull path clipped to the disc.
- **Screen space only for type**: readings, verdict, counter, source line, subtitle slip. Each reading is pinned to its stack through the same projection as the camera.
- No live 3D; no live blur; textures are drawn once and only moved.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the seamless sweep; `--latar-2` the paper plates behind readings, the verdict and the subtitle slip.
- `--aksen` tints the acrylic series; `--utama` is the single signal colour: the counter value, the verdict plate and its underline, the closing card's contact chip. Words on the sweep use `--utama-di-latar` / `--aksen-di-latar`.
- Fixed in every brand: aluminium, brass, walnut, inlay cream, cast shadow, highlights, and the cool-sky and olive reflection colours of the metal.
- The example's own colours are the film's: sweep `#ddd5c9`, signal `#d4521c`, acrylic `#79cfc2`, aluminium `#c8ccd1`, brass `#d2b07a`, ink `#1c1d20`.
- No rainbow series, no colour ramps on the objects.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` and `--font-isi`: a quiet grotesk (Inter 400/600). Counter 130–170 px at 1920 wide, readings 40–52 px, verdict and subtitle 26–34 px, source line 20 px.
- Monospace (IBM Plex Mono) for units, months and credits, not replaceable by the brand.
- A reading is a dot on the stack, a 1.4 px leader, a swatch of the series' material, a category line, then value and unit on a translucent paper plate. Two readings of a pair share a column, larger value on top.
- The verdict sits upper left on its own plate in the signal colour, with a growing rule, only after the readings have been still 2.5 s or more.

## 5. Motion quality

- 30 fps world, the camera never stops (2-3 % creep on holds); camera keys are joined by a monotone cubic.
- **Cascade**: a stack assembles bottom to top in 0.5-1.25 s, the plates arriving with ease-out, plastic after paper by 0.2-0.4 s.
- **Feed**: one period's increase arrives plate by plate, a new plate every 0.033 s, each falling 0.42 s on a quintic ease-out with a yaw that unwinds ("placed", not "dropped"); the counter rolls with the plates landed.
- Readings fade in over 0.3 s and draw their leader; they leave by fading. Landed plates, the base and rulers never move.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Low dolly along the spiral | the unit is real; time passing | opening, a sequence of months or sites |
| Crane up to a locked three-quarter | comparison | A against B, a crossover |
| Fast chase along the spiral | speeding up | a year's growth, a ranking |
| Crane with the rising top | accumulation | one period's increase, a target reached |
| Hold at the finished stack | the result as an object | the ending, a contact card |

The subject fills at least a third of the frame height at key moments; readings live in empty background; comparisons keep both stacks in frame. Transitions are camera moves in one continuous take, no cuts.

## 7. Native moves

- **The rule line.** One sentence says what a plate is and what a brass plate is, once, while the camera glides past. *Fits content like:* kilos of waste, hours of lessons, servings sold, followers gained.
- **The paired climb.** Two series on one disc, one material each, built month by month; the crossover is held still with four readings before the verdict. *Fits content like:* paper against plastic, income against spending, two classes' attendance.
- **The feed.** The last period's increase is placed plate by plate on the previous level while the counter rolls. *Fits content like:* this month's sales, new subscribers, a harvest, a savings goal.
- **The finished pile.** The camera settles beside the final stack and the closing plate holds. *Fits content like:* a community drive, a creator's milestone, a school's year, a shop's contact card.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Stacks that read as bars: keep the per-plate offsets, gaps and brass rulers.
- A reading that overlaps the subtitle slip or the verdict; keep readings in empty background.
- Verdict before the numbers have been still; the viewer must read first.
- Plates that scale instead of landing; growth is always placed pieces.
- Heavy 3D: keep to a few flat planes with `matrix3d`, never real preserve-3d scenes of thousands of nodes.
- Series that share a material or whose hue only differs by brand colour: they must separate in grey.

# Data as objects: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.8, long 4.0.

## hook

- en: low camera glides along a spiral of stacks while plates are placed bottom to top; the unit rule is said once
- id: kamera rendah menyusuri spiral tumpukan sementara lempeng ditata dari bawah; aturan satuan disebut sekali

## problem

- en: the stacks stay put and a reading plate points at the one that is too tall or too short, no cut
- id: tumpukan diam, pelat bacaan menunjuk tumpukan yang terlalu tinggi atau terlalu rendah, tanpa potongan

## fact

- en: one reading pinned to a stack by a dot and hairline leader on a paper plate, the source line in the corner
- id: satu bacaan ditempel ke tumpukan lewat titik dan garis tipis di pelat kertas, sumber di pojok

## step

- en: one stack per step along the spiral as the camera tracks; each is built plate by plate and read once
- id: satu tumpukan tiap langkah menyusuri spiral sementara kamera mengikuti; ditata lempeng demi lempeng

## compare

- en: locked three-quarter frame on two stacks in two materials; four readings still, then the verdict plate and rule
- id: bingkai tiga perempat terkunci pada dua tumpukan beda bahan; empat bacaan diam, lalu pelat vonis dan garis

## number

- en: crane up with the rising top while plates are fed one by one; the counter rolls with each plate that lands
- id: kamera naik bersama puncak tumpukan, lempeng diumpankan satu per satu; penghitung ikut tiap lempeng yang mendarat

## proof

- en: pull the camera to the finished stack with its brass rulers and count them aloud in the reading plate
- id: kamera menepi ke tumpukan jadi dengan lempeng kuningannya, jumlahnya dibaca di pelat bacaan

## offer

- en: the last stack stands still beside a paper plate carrying the offer and price in the signal colour
- id: tumpukan terakhir diam di samping pelat kertas berisi tawaran dan harga berwarna utama

## cta

- en: camera settles beside the final stack; name and contact on a plate upper left, still for 2 s or more
- id: kamera berhenti di samping tumpukan akhir; nama dan kontak di pelat kiri atas, diam 2 detik lebih

## payoff

- en: the finished pile held in a slow creep, the counter at its final value and the source line in frame
- id: tumpukan jadi ditahan dengan gerak pelan, penghitung di nilai akhir dan sumber tetap tampil

    <script>

      const K = 320, P = 2778, TH = 4, SW = 160, SD = 134.4, R0 = 1072, END = 15;

      const BLN = ["JAN", "FEB", "MAR", "APR", "MEI", "JUN", "JUL", "AGU", "SEP", "OKT", "NOV", "DES"];
      const SETOR = { p: [170, 221, 284, 362, 449, 552, 683, 829, 1012, 1219, 1471, 1764], k: [340, 405, 466, 521, 578, 641, 712, 788, 862, 948, 1031, 1118] };

      } })();

      DES.nb = NOV.n; // Desember naik dulu ke level November, sisanya diumpankan
      const NEW = DES.n - DES.nb;

        const c = t < s.b ? 0 : Math.floor(s.nb * Math.pow(seg(t, s.b, s.b + s.L), 1 / 0.85) + 1e-9);

      const css = getComputedStyle(doc), hex = (n) => { const h = css.getPropertyValue(n).trim(); return [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16)); };
      const mix = (a, b, t) => a.map((v, i) => v + (b[i] - v) * t), rgba = (c, al = 1) => `rgba(${c.map((v) => Math.round(clamp(v, 0, 255))).join(",")},${al})`;
      const [LATAR, AKSEN, ALUM, KUN, KAYU, INLAY, GELAP, KILAP, LANGIT, PANTUL] = ["--latar", "--aksen", "--aluminium", "--kuningan", "--kayu", "--inlay", "--gelap", "--kilap", "--langit", "--pantul"].map(hex);
      const ALU = mix(ALUM, LATAR, 0.12);
      // Empat sisi (luar, +x, dalam, −x): logam memantul zaitun-emas, makin gelap menjauhi cahaya; akrilik = --aksen digelapkan dengan kroma dinaikkan (bahan bening berwarna). "s" = tumpukan Desember dari dekat: sisi luar perak terang.
